name: scxml-tool
description: A minimal standalone graphical SCXML simulation environment.

scripts.watch: tsc -p . --outDir dist/ -w & ( cd dist/; watchify --exclude electron --bare index.js -d -v -o 'cat > scxml-tool.js; sorcery -i scxml-tool.js; npm run minify' -v )
scripts.build: npm run transpile && npm run bundle && npm run minify
scripts.bundle: cd dist/; browserify --exclude electron --bare  index.js  -d -v -o scxml-tool.js; sorcery -i scxml-tool.js
scripts.minify: cd dist/; uglifyjs scxml-tool.js --in-source-map scxml-tool.js.map  --source-map scxml-tool.min.js.map  -o scxml-tool.min.js

author: Jacob Beard <jake@jacobeanrnd.com>
